findings_and_reconnections.classification: partial reconnection q161 and q377; two preserved historical identities, no formal alias decision
findings_and_reconnections.trace: HairSeed::from_word accepts every i32, casting through u32 to canonical Seed, and word returns the same signed word. Look::groom takes word() and unconditionally forms seed + 9 for Orient; i32::MAX is admitted, so overflow-checked arithmetic fails and wrapping configurations use a wrapped value. Parent already proved source-only mathematical existence of a Look.random generator state yielding i32::MAX; no seed witness or generator execution. Look::guides separately casts signed word to u64, which sign-extends negative values as a distinct deterministic representation, not evidence of a defect by itself.

findings_and_reconnections.classification: partial reconnection q378, with pinned native source
findings_and_reconnections.trace: Strands derives Default with points=0 although its documented and new() invariant is at least2. Frizz::apply reads points and invokes positions.par_chunks_mut(points). Cargo.lock pins Rayon 1.12.0; its exact checksum-verified source asserts chunk_size != 0 immediately, even on an empty slice. Direct applying Frizz to default strands therefore reaches the assertion. Empty sets are legitimate when constructed as Strands::new(2). Groom::grow_while resamples at max(points,2), so do not claim this direct-default failure on that normalizing route.

findings_and_reconnections.classification: partial reconnection q380; additional correlated-state and mutation evidence
findings_and_reconnections.trace: CurveSampler derives Default, so at_length on its empty state computes n-1 and/or eventually indexes nonexistent data according to overflow behavior. new(empty) also admits an empty sampler; set(one-point) instead replaces positions and lengths, clears tangents, and reaches tangents strand[1] before normals are refreshed. If an unwind is caught, the prior sampler has already been partly overwritten. Its public positions, lengths, tangents and normals can also be independently changed after a valid construction: clearing normals while leaving a two-point curve intact makes at_length access normals[0] without rechecking the vectors. These are source-representable cases, not observed runtime failures.

findings_and_reconnections.classification: newly assessed source-level correctness/policy candidate; central alias search open
findings_and_reconnections.trace: For a two-point strand [origin,(1e-13,0,0)] metres, the squared length is about 1e-26, a nonzero normal f32 value. Vec3.length is positive and smaller than 1e-12. resample_into with output length3 treats the positive span as zero and selects t=0 for every output, collapsing the tip to the root. CurveSampler.at_factor(1) likewise treats the positive span as zero and returns its root, despite its documented sampling-at-factor behavior. Separately ops::parameters divides the positive total by max(total,1e-12), so its tip factor is below1. These are exact control-flow and magnitude arguments with no fixture or algorithm run; no ordinary generated-hair witness or physical minimum policy is claimed.

findings_and_reconnections.trace: For the same finite nonzero +X segment of length about 1e-13 metres, tangents computes its direction and safe_normalize compares its positive representable norm with 1e-12. It returns fallback Vec3::up, changing the tangent from +X to +Y. The squared input magnitude is normal in f32; this is not necessary merely to avoid squared-length underflow. In restore_lengths, the same absolute threshold selects reference direction rather than current direction for a small nonzero segment. The applicable crate rule calls for exact positivity for presence, checked vector normalization and owned tolerances with units/error budgets.

findings_and_reconnections.classification: open sampling contract for unusually large public choices, not a claimed runtime regression
findings_and_reconnections.trace: For n=16,777,217, n as f32 rounds to 16,777,216 under IEEE nearest-even. next_f32 has 24 binary fraction bits and a maximum of 1-2^-24, so the product is at most 16,777,215. Thus index 16,777,216 cannot be selected, although it is a valid index. Sample::draw accepts a preset slice of arbitrary length, but no such allocation or ordinary caller is demonstrated. index documents only a valid index, so whether each option must remain reachable is a sampling-policy question, separate from n=0 and ordinary small-array deterministic mapping.

nonfindings_and_open_contracts: StrandCount, PointsPerStrand and GuideNeighborCount are semantic roles, not checked positivity, allocation or GPU-width guarantees; valid zero strand count is not forbidden. HairSeed preserves i32 bit patterns; choose overflow policy in the derivation operation, not by silently excluding all large input.

Fixed ordinary Look.new point counts are 8–160; Look.random clamps to at most256. Arbitrary public/Serde Look and direct operations are separate. Normal Look.guides supplies 64 points; no general default-path panic claim.
Look.preset is documented as the preset the look started from, not necessarily its current hairstyle. Do not flag it as automatically redundant current authority.
With zero source and empty output, resample_into skips its loop and does not index; do not invent an empty-output failure. Strands::new(2) with zero strands is valid, unlike its derived Default.

Vec3.normalize returns the original zero vector when length is zero, so exactly zero current and reference segments do not themselves generate NaN by zero normalization. Nonfinite input behavior remains outside this narrow proof.

Stream intentionally wraps a 32-bit counter and Rng intentionally wraps 64-bit state; these define native numerical kernels. CPU/WGSL byte-for-byte parity remains unverified without all connected shader bodies and is not inferred from names.

The documented normal draw clamps u away from zero, and both finite-bit draws and this clamp affect tails; whether exact normal distribution is required is a policy question, not a measured or sampled defect.
Index selection for ordinary Look uses fixed positive ranges. The direct Sample.draw empty slice is a newly traced public caller, not a claim that any production caller supplies an empty slice.
Two source test modules and native dependency snippets were inspected only. No builds, tests, runtime probes, simulations, fixtures, implementations or product validation were run.
